component.name: Finder
component.summary: A native macOS Finder-inspired file manager for Linux

description.p: Finder Linux is a native Qt 6 file manager designed to feel familiar to users coming from macOS Finder while integrating with freedesktop.org and KDE Plasma desktop services.

ul.li: Icon, list, column, and gallery views
Quick Look previews for images, text, PDF, video, and audio
Split-pane browsing with synchronized folders and pane-to-pane copy/move
XDG Trash support with restore, conflict handling, and optional auto-purge
Archive creation and extraction, including optional ZIP AES encryption
KDE service-menu actions and XDG recent-file integration
Metadata-preserving file operations and SHA-256 checksums
